# Security policy

This policy applies to every MRAIA-ORG repository that has no security policy of its own.

## Report a vulnerability

Report a security flaw in private. Do not open a public issue or pull request for it.

1. Go to the repository that has the flaw.
2. Open the **Security** tab.
3. Click **Report a vulnerability**.
4. Write what the flaw is, which version or commit has it, and the steps that show it.

Only the maintainers of the repository can see your report. We reply in the same report.

## Supported versions

We fix security flaws in the latest release only. At this time there is no release. Until the first release, we fix flaws on the default branch.

## How we announce fixes

We publish each fix as a GitHub security advisory on the repository that has the flaw. To get an alert, watch the repository and select **Security alerts**.
